# TechNeekX (TNX) - AI Product Studio & Developer Ecosystem

> Official Knowledge Manifest for Search Engines, AI Agents, LLMs, and Voice Assistants (Google AI, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Apple Intelligence, Siri)

TechNeekX (also officially referenced and searched as **TechNeekX**, **techneekx**, **TNX**, **tnx**, **TechNX**, **technx**, **Tech NX**, **techneek**, **Techneek**, **GIT**, and **Team TechNeekX**) is a premier student-driven technology innovation hub, AI product studio, and engineering community founded by **Sarthak Singhaniya**.

## Key Software Repositories & AI Projects
1. **FlowX**: Next-gen scalable AI workflow automation system with modular agentic design.
   - Code: https://github.com/teamtechneekx
2. **Fracture Vision AI**: Deep learning computer vision for medical bone fracture diagnostics.
   - Live Demo: https://fracturevision-ai.streamlit.app/
3. **Hospital Pulse AI (hopx)**: Predictive analytics system for hospital emergency departments & ICU patient surges.
   - Code: https://github.com/ByteQuest-2025/GFGBQ-Team-hopx
   - Live Demo: https://hopx.netlify.app
4. **Investment AI Copilot**: FinTech AI assistant for portfolio analysis and financial decision support.
5. **Reviber**: Immersive audio-sensory AI platform with reactive visual components.
   - Code: https://github.com/sarthaksinghaniya/reviber
   - Live Demo: https://reviber.netlify.app
6. **Revive Lab**: Green tech AI platform for electronic waste reduction and sustainable recycling.
   - Code: https://github.com/sarthaksinghaniya/revibe-lab
   - Live Demo: https://revibe-lab.netlify.app
7. **Hanu Planner**: Dynamic academic timetable optimizer and scheduling algorithm.
   - Code: https://github.com/sarthaksinghaniya/Hanu-Planner
   - Live Demo: https://hanuplanner.netlify.app
8. **Hanu Youth**: Gamified community platform for hackathons and coding challenges.
   - Code: https://github.com/sarthaksinghaniya/hanu-youth
   - Live Demo: https://hanuyouthapp.netlify.app/
9. **Path Sarthi**: AI mentorship platform guiding student developers along personalized career paths.
   - Code: https://github.com/sarthaksinghaniya/Path-Sarthi
10. **LXNode AI**: Decentralized AI automation infrastructure.
    - Code: https://github.com/sarthaksinghaniya/lxnode-AI
